supporting_observations.claim: At 14:16:09 UTC, Explorer wrote an ivy.chen UserAssist value whose ROT13-encoded path decodes to C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe. This supports PowerShell having been used, but the record does not establish that it was launched around 13:40.
Proxy records at 13:40 show ivy.chen's browser connecting to and retrieving content from login.salesforce.com. They do not identify a PowerShell process or explain the reported window.

The documented business-hours workstation patching practice is a possible legitimate explanation for PowerShell, but the available records do not link this activity to sam.okafor, WS-SOKAFOR-01, Apply-Updates.ps1, or an authorized patching action on WS-ICHEN-01.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor-coverage status says winsec and sysmon were not collected on WS-ICHEN-01 from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC because of a log collection outage. This includes the reported alert time.
Proxy and network records are available during the outage, but they do not provide endpoint process creation, command line, parent process, or PowerShell script content for the reported activity.
claims_not_established: Whether PowerShell was actually open at approximately 13:40, or whether the UserAssist write at 14:16 reflects the reported event.
What account, command line, parent process, script, or mechanism launched PowerShell.
Whether the activity was the documented workstation patching action or another legitimate task.
Whether the activity was malicious; the endpoint evidence needed to evaluate that alternative is unavailable for the alert window.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover endpoint process and PowerShell telemetry for WS-ICHEN-01 during 13:30–14:10 UTC, including process creation details, command lines, parent processes, PowerShell operational logs, and any retained EDR data.
Check relevant local artifacts, such as PowerShell history, Prefetch, and UserAssist execution timing, to determine whether PowerShell ran near 13:40 and what launched it.
Verify whether sam.okafor performed scheduled patching on WS-ICHEN-01, including records from WS-SOKAFOR-01, FILE-NWD-01 share or script access, and any associated change or patch records.
unrelated_findings: At 13:26, WS-ICHEN-01 connected to desktop.dropbox.com with a DropboxUpdate user agent. Dropbox is not listed as approved, but this record alone does not establish file sharing or storage activity; handle separately. (T054-00061, T054-00062)

GlobalProtect ran under ivy.chen shortly before the reported time, and Cisco AnyConnect's vpnagent started later in the review window. The inventory says there is no VPN; these process records do not establish an active VPN connection or link either process to the alerted PowerShell activity. Handle separately.
